{{Quote|He will never be a ''great'' Jedi.|The Jedi Master, on Dass Jennir|<ref name="DT 20" />}}
This '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' served as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
She examined a young [[Dass Jennir]], and reported that while he had strong concentration, his overall connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was not. She informed [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] that she believed Jennir would never be a great [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], to which he questioned.
